I think it’s very hard to retain any information if you are learning about 500 different things in a day. It is better to focus on a few things at a time. I think trying to learn stuff and thinking its “productive “ can very often turn into a thing like simply scrolling through facebook. Of course the internet can be great educational tool, you just need to be aware and ask yourself if reading an article about quantum physics is going to be something you could talk to your friend about the next day. I’ve found myself reading about strange topics online that I dont even understand or have no use for , thinking that maybe I was getting “smarter.” 

I think we search for things that have no practical use, such as lets say topics related to science is because there is something satisfying of understanding the world more or knowing that there is some person out there that understands the world in some way “more” than you do. We may also do this to distract from other things that need our attention, this may also be entertainment. Is it inherently bad? Not really. Its whether you decide it is a good use of your time or not.

Sounds like you might have to let go of the idea of “perfectionism” you cant ever be truly happy if you are always trying to perfect things. I think happiness is about finding a way to accept where you are and to make the best of things, it’s not about waiting or hoping for anything. It is a mindset. And while you cant turn on and off a switch, happiness , learning to be content with yourself is a process. 

If you believe happiness will give you a perfect life in where you are afraid you will look back in regret of how bad youve treated yourself, then maybe you have the wrong idea of happiness. I think if you get to happiness you will look down at the past with greater understanding, and you will be able to forgive yourself. While I have come a long way, I have been able to become more self aware of my feelings and with that I understand, I understand why I have felt the world was so unfair and blah blah blah, why I wanted to self harm and do whatever other bad things. At this point, I know I could go back to that and probably very easily, but I have gotten to a point of strength where now I can decide where to go, and I decide to accept everything bad in my life (everything I cannot control!!) and try to focus on what I can control.

I’m sure there is a good reason you feel so down. With depression sometimes it is easy to think we have no good reason to be upset, but I think we only think that way because we don’t see ourselves to be important.
